search_routing.routing_rationale: Naukri server automatically redirects /jobs?k= to /jobs-in-india which fails to render job card tuples (0 results). Structured SEO slugs with query parameters reliably return 20 job cards per page.

sanitization_standards.zero_comma_rule: Commas must be stripped from all query tokens, location strings, and input fields. Commas encode as %2C which Naukri parses literally as '2c', collapsing results to 0.
sanitization_standards.plain_text_slug_rule: Slugification must be performed on raw plain text tokens (e.g. clean_q) using re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text.lower()).strip('-'). Never call urllib.parse.quote before slugifying, which turns spaces into %20 and results in corrupted slugs like 'java-20technical-20lead'.
sanitization_standards.suggestor_trailing_comma_stripping: Selecting suggestion chips in Naukri auto-appends ', '. In-DOM JavaScript must proactively strip trailing commas before executing search.
sanitization_standards.isolated_designation_rule: Each search must execute exactly one single designation string. Multiple roles must NEVER be concatenated into the search field.

dom_selectors.read_more_button: span.styles_rm-link__RgrMs, .customReadMoreLabelClass, .styles_read-more-link__dD_5h, .read-more-label, span.rm-link, div[class*='read-more'] span, div[class*='read-more'] a

circuit_breakers.zero_experience_screening: If candidate answers 0 years for a core technology named in the job title or >=50% of experience questions resolve to 0, abort application immediately without submitting.
circuit_breakers.naukri_keyskills_false: If Naukri native match score container shows Keyskills: false (Red Cross), disqualify immediately unless candidate primary title matches.

linkedin.notes: Legacy classes .job-card-list__title / .job-card-container__company-name / .job-card-container__metadata-item no longer render on cards; kept as fallbacks. Cards carry no exp/salary bands; seniority lives in the detail pane.
